macro.silhouette: Ancient stone rails contain a vertically grown wood structure while the shared angular geometry remains unchanged.
macro.focalPath: The luminous seed and root cradle lead downward through resonance, progress, and claim actions.

joins: stone plates occlude wood rail terminations
moss grows from stone-to-wood damp seams
roots connect the focal to named wood and moss receivers

micro.panel: Sparse fractures, limited anchored knots, seam lichen, and four low-opacity variation specks stay outside the central content lane.
micro.primaryAction: At most two anchored authored clusters and two specks support one wood body with stone end caps.
micro.compactControls: At most one anchored cluster and one speck; progress uses no clusters, specks, or ornament.

stone.positive: Structural plates follow exposed edges and use selective bevel, fracture, and contact occlusion.
stone.prohibited: Floating centred stone decals or a uniform outline around every surface.

wood.positive: Growth follows declared vertical panel rails or horizontal action bodies and terminates beneath structural masks.
wood.prohibited: Broad decorative ribbons crossing semantic content or equal grain density on every component.

moss.positive: Growth starts at a named damp stone-to-wood seam and transitions irregularly along that substrate.
moss.prohibited: Repeated centred moss stickers or unanchored lichen dots.

livingLight.positive: A bounded emitter drives separately named stone, wood, moss, and edge receivers near the focal or state cue.
livingLight.prohibited: Uniform cyan overlay, global-opacity-only state changes, fire, or ice language.
